finding: F2 selection record section 12.5 row 12; 05-work-agents-skills.md section 9
case: Work admitted in a duty class whose acceptance role is unfilled.
why: Section 12.5 row 12, R-X09 and R-D09, against AC-M3-02 / AC-M4-02 / AE-M4-05. The mutation deletes the phase binding and leaves the holder reference demanded, so the admission still NAMES a holder while nothing requires that holder to be staffed. Admission-narrowing is the behaviour when a standing acceptance role is unfilled, and this binding is the whole of it.
